book.title: Matta Laɓara na Mbǝnggǝn aten Yeeso

content: Wunni manggǝn hu Kutǝryid Faara
Ahu sayidɗiya ɓagha fatsahaya thlǝmad Yeeso ɓa tsahang mee nda, “Wunni manggǝn hu Kutǝryid Faara?”
Aagha Yeeso wundakhne ɓa na ngguchit ishanggǝn a maɗufun ndan.
Tǝrgha ndaagha, “Niya pǝrang ƙǝkafek kun, a malanggun ɗimiyid nun tsawun ƙǝla wanɗi na ngguchit ya wa mbun tam kyarha hu Kutǝryid Faara ɗǝ wa.
Nanǝn kee kala niifa manangwawa altenggǝn tsauka ƙǝla wanɗi na ngguchit ya ndǝghǝn ni na manggǝn hu Kutǝryid Faara.
Kala niifa thlǝgha wundakhne fa ƙǝla yanɗiya ahu thlǝmna nggini thlǝnǝn fa.”
Əngya na kyang niifa hu ɗimiyirha hai
Amma ana niifasǝ kyangga tal ahur wanggini na nggu-ngguchit ya fǝrgha ƙǝkafek a nggi ahu ɗimiyirha hai, a nggushi waghang nda fǝn hǝrha ura mughang ngganda ahu wuri aama ɗǝ.
Kawa ƙǝshiirha ƙǝsǝr ka ǝnggini na nda ǝnaarha kyang ngganda fiya hu ɗimiyirha hai. Ənggini na kyang nda fiya hu ɗimiyirha hai tǝtani a ɓagha ɓa, amma na sǝbrha hura a ƙǝla niifɗa fa ǝnagha kee.

Ana harwa nduwa sarwa a kyorha hu ɗimiyirha hai, kyathlang ɗǝ muwangga ɗǝ. A nggushi kyana hu ahu yibrha ɗǝ mbuwa ngwalarha tǝ haara tal nduwa saara tal ma nana tǝ haara kyab nduwa saara kyab muwo wanda ahu waarha ɗǝ mbuwa mǝra hai.
A kyo yidwa ahu ɗimiyirha hai, ƙǝɗang ɗǝ muwangga ɗǝ. A nggushi kyana ahu yibrha ɗǝ mbuwa ngwalarha tǝ yirha tal, ma muwo wanda ahu waarha ɗǝ mbuwa mǝra hai tǝ yidwa kyab.
Kwarama, a sarɗun wanggini na nggu-ngguchit ya wa. Ƙǝsǝr niya ndang nda kun a talara wan thlǝngya Faar ndan na nda naarha a mbed Pǝpa na a talara.
Ƙǝsǝr Wan niifa ɓanǝnɓa ka a hǝrghanggǝn fingya sahadgha.
Karapu aten chaurarha sahadgha
Ana niifa tǝ chauraya haru tal, tǝrgha tal sahadgha, ma nǝn ǝnaarha? Mbǝ mal kumnggit wutarihe kap wutarihe a mbǝd lafrha ɗǝgha ka kaɗa yanɗaɗǝ sahadgha wa?
A walang ɗaɓa, niya pǝrang ƙǝkafek kun, nǝn tǝk mbǝnda fa kaan aten chauradɗi tal ma kumnggit wutarihe kap wutarihe ɗi sahadwa wa!
Nǝghǝn kee ƙǝm, mbǝ nggǝmnda hur Pǝpa ni na a talara ko tal ahur wanggini na nggu-ngguchit ya sahadgha wa.
A ǝno shadwa ɗimiyirha fa
A ǝno shadwa ɗimiyirha fa, ɗuwa thlǝmadghǝn ɗǝ kyaɗang ɗimiyidghǝn, a pathlang nun kun sǝri. A koɗǝ thlǝmaarha fa, wuɗang na ɓa.
Amma a kowa thlǝmaarha fa wa, turu niifa tal nduwa sǝri ɗun thlǝmadghǝn ɗǝ tǝna laɓaara kyarhaɓa a mii nafiya sǝri nduwa mahan tsauka shedawaya atenggǝn.
A karɗǝ kang thlǝmaarha kanda fa, pǝranggǝn mamngya Ƙǝn Faara. A karɗǝ kang thlǝmaarha mamngya Ƙǝn Faara fa, tsawang niifɗiya tǝ takkwa ɗaharha ni nduwa tǝ thlǝ tsamnda.
Niya pǝrang ƙǝkafek kun, kala ˈya ƙǝnang nun hai hu ƙǝshiirha nǝghǝn ƙǝƙǝna hai ƙǝm a talara. Kala ˈya kwasang nun hai hu ƙǝshiirha, nǝghǝn kukwasa hai kee a talara.
“Niya nggǝr ndang nda kun, ana nafiya sǝ sǝri ahur nun hu ƙǝshiirha nggǝmngga fa aten ˈya nun a hwanda, Pǝpa na a talara a fǝranggǝn kun.
Ƙǝsǝr kala mbǝrha wumna fiya sa hai sǝri nduwa mahan ahu thlǝmna niyi a pathlang ndan.”
Karapu aten mafarha kargha chakh ɗimiyirha fa
Tǝrgha ɓagha Mbiturus thlǝmadghǝn ɓa tsahang mee nǝn, “Chinǝm, saara kurmi ni chahanggǝn shadna ɗǝ a ǝneeɗǝ ɗimiyirha fa? Saara mǝd wa?”
Nggǝrangga Yeeso sǝ, “Awo, mbǝ katǝra mǝd kee wa, amma kumnggit mǝd katǝra mǝd!
Tsaunǝn kee, Kutǝryid talara nǝghǝn ƙǝla kutǝra na midghǝn kirassa ƙǝnaghǝn na a har mafayighǝn nzǝmngga wuɗǝɓǝla a harghǝn.
Katǝrang nǝn hai kee, ɓang niifa nda ɓa nǝn a takkwarha wuɗǝɓǝl wurirha haru kumnggidghǝn tuf.
Nanǝn mbǝ mbang tiighǝn wa, tǝrgha kutǝrɗi ndǝghǝn a heng ngganda ɗǝ tǝ nukkun, tǝ wanggighǝn tǝ ǝngya nanǝn tǝghǝn ha heu a tii kumadɗa nǝn.
Ɓǝrgha mafadɗa hai a mbedghǝn hwanggǝnǝn, ‘Niya hwan sa, ƙǝrsu tǝ nggi, niya tiighǝn heu.’
Tǝrgha kutǝrɗi haɗanggǝn fa, kalghǝnǝn hai chahang kumadɗa nǝn ɗǝ.”
“Amma kyana mafadɗi ƙǝshaaɗǝ, ɗǝgha wal shadghǝn mafarha nǝn a takkwarha wuɗǝɓǝl wurirha haru tal. Ƙǝsanggǝn, ˈyaɓanggǝn, ndanggǝn, ‘Tee kumad na.’
Ɓǝrgha shadɗa hai keeghǝn hwanggǝnǝn, ‘Ƙǝrsu tǝ nggi niya teuƙǝn.’
Amma kargha fa ƙǝsanggǝn muwanggǝn ahu porsǝna ɗǝ ƙǝl tii nǝn wuɗǝɓǝlɗi heu.
Nana fingya mafaya ǝnɗi katǝragha hai, sǝbgha hur ndan ɗǝ. Ɗǝnda thlǝmad kutǝrɗa ɗǝ pǝrang ǝnɗa nda katǝragha hai.
Tǝrgha kutǝrɗi aah mafadɗa nǝn ɓa chahang nǝn kumarha ɗǝ ndanggǝn, ‘Sa ka wuɗi mafarha! Chahoɗi kumarha ɗǝ na a tenwa ka hwanna nggi.
Mbǝ shadwa mafarha haɗo fa ƙǝla haɗoni fa wa?’
Tǝrgha kutǝrɗi hu sǝbrha hura muwanggǝn hu porsǝna ɗǝ ƙǝl a tii ɗǝ kumadɗi heu.
Na Pǝpa na a talara a ǝnang kun kee a kowunni kargha chahang ˈya shadghǝn ɗǝ tǝ hura tal.”
